Amigos Daily Specials: Classic Mexican Menu, Happy Hour, and More

Welcome to the ultimate guide on Amigos Daily Specials, your one-stop resource for exploring everything about Amigos, the classic Mexican restaurant known for its flavorful menu, unbeatable daily specials, and vibrant happy hour deals. Whether you’re craving spicy tacos, cheesy queso, or a refreshing drink, this guide will help you discover what to order, where to find the best deal, and how to save on your next visit. Let’s dive into the delicious world of Amigos!

Why Amigos is the Go-To Mexican Restaurant for Daily Specials

When it comes to a Mexican restaurant that delivers both taste and value, Amigos stands out with its classic flavors, hearty portions, and amazing daily specials. Every day brings something new to the table, making it a top restaurant choice for those who love Mexican food and crave a deal. If you’re interested in learning about the history of Mexican cuisine and what makes it so beloved, Britannica has a great overview.

Amigos Menu: A Classic Mexican Food Experience

At Amigos, the menu is all about fresh ingredients, traditional recipes, and bold flavors. From tacos and queso to spicy sauces, every bite is a fiesta.

Below is a quick look at some customer favorites:

Daily Specials at Amigos: What’s the Deal?

One of the best reasons to visit Amigos is the daily specials. Each day brings a new special or coupon you can use to get more food and drink for less. Here’s a breakdown.

Monday Specials: Start Your Week Right

Monday is all about beating the Monday blues with hearty Mexican food and drink deals.

Features:

  • $2 Classic Tacos

  • $1 Off Amigos Dip

  • $3 Queso & Chips

Tip: Pair your tacos with the creamy queso for extra flavor.

Tuesday Specials: Taco Tuesday at Amigos

Taco Tuesday is a staple at any Mexican grill, and Amigos does it best.

Features:

  • Buy 2 Get 1 Free Tacos

  • $4 House Margaritas

  • Free Side of Guacamole with Any Taco Order

Wednesday Specials: Midweek Happy Hour

Wednesdays at Amigos restaurant come with a refreshing happy hour twist.

Features:

  • Half-Price Queso Dip

  • $5 Specialty Drinks

  • $2 Off Any Enchilada

Amigos Happy Hour: When and What to Expect

The Amigos happy hour runs daily from 3 PM to 6 PM, making it the perfect hour to grab food and drink at unbeatable prices.

Happy Hour Menu:

Item Price
Amigos Classic Margarita $4
Draft Beer $3
Chips & Amigos Queso $2.50
Amigo Dip Sampler $5

Where is Amigos Located? Find Your Nearest Location

Amigos has multiple locations across the city, so there’s always a restaurant nearby when those taco cravings hit.

Top Locations:

  • Amigos Cantina – Downtown City Center

  • Amigos Grill & Bar – Northside Plaza

  • Amigos Classic Mexican – Westend Strip

Tip: Check your local Amigos restaurant for location-specific daily specials.

Must-Try Classic Mexican Menu Items

Let’s look at some timeless favorites that make the Amigos menu so popular.

Tacos at Amigos: Endless Choice

Tacos are a classic at any Mexican restaurant, and Amigos does them right.

Popular Tacos:

  • Spicy Beef Taco: Seasoned with zesty sauce, topped with fresh pico de gallo.

  • Chorizo Taco: Smoky chorizo, melted cheddar, fresh lime.

  • Steak Taco: Grilled steak, creamy ranch, spicy jalapeños.

Queso and Dips: The Ultimate Side

No Mexican grill is complete without a good queso.

Dip Description Price
Amigos Queso Classic melted cheese dip $5.49
Amigo Dip Signature blend of cheese, beans, sauce $5.99
Guacamole Fresh avocado, zesty lime, pico de gallo $4.99

Burritos and Wraps: Big Flavors

Wrap your hunger with a hearty burrito or wrap.

  • Steak Wrap: Grilled steak, cheddar, creamy sauce.

  • Classic Burrito: Seasoned beef, beans, cheddar, ranch.

  • Spicy Chorizo Wrap: Chorizo, jalapeños, jack cheese, spicy sauce.

Amigos Special Deals: How to Save More

Want to save big at Amigos restaurant? Use their coupons, join their loyalty club, and follow these tips:

  • Join Amigos Rewards: Earn points every time you order.

  • Sign Up for Emails: Get the latest deal or coupon directly.

  • Visit During Happy Hour: Double up your food and drink for less.

  • Order Classic Combos: Combine tacos, sides, and drinks.

Amigos Drinks Menu: Refresh and Relax

Pair your meal with a cold drink. Amigos serves up everything from classic sodas to specialty cocktails.

Popular Drinks:

  • Classic Margarita

  • Amigos Cantina Tequila Shot

  • Draft Beer

  • Fresh Lime Mojito

Amigos Food and Drink: Classic Mexican Flavors

Every dish at Amigos celebrates authentic Mexican ingredients like tortilla, cheese, chorizo, and fresh salsa.

Must-Have Flavors:

  • Jack Cheese: Mild and creamy.

  • Pico de Gallo: Fresh tomatoes, onions, cilantro.

  • Zesty Sauces: Add a spicy kick.

Amigos Coupons and Specials: Find Today’s Special

Before you order, check for today’s special or coupon. Many Amigos locations offer local deals, so you can always find a way to save.

How to Order Amigos Daily Specials

Ordering from Amigos is easy:

  1. Visit your nearest location.

  2. Browse the menu or daily specials board.

  3. Place your order at the counter or online.

  4. Grab your food and drink, enjoy, and don’t forget to grab extra sauce!

What Makes Amigos the Best Mexican Restaurant?

  • Classic Menu: Timeless flavors you crave.

  • Daily Specials: A new deal every day.

  • Happy Hour: Best food and drink prices during the best hour.

  • Friendly Atmosphere: Warm vibes at every location.

Amigos Catering: Bring the Grill to Your Place

Hosting a party or event? Bring the Amigos grill to you with their catering service.

Options:

  • Taco Bar

  • Queso and Chips Platters

  • Amigos Wraps and Burritos

  • Drinks and Sides

FAQs About Amigos Daily Specials

What days have the best deals?

Monday, Tuesday, and Wednesday are top picks, but check today’s special for extra savings.

Does Amigos have happy hour?

Yes! The happy hour is daily from 3 PM – 6 PM.

Are there vegetarian options?

Absolutely! Try the bean burritos, cheese quesadillas, and fresh guacamole.

Can I get Amigos specials to go?

Yes, you can order online for pickup or delivery.

Final Tips to Save at Amigos

  • Always ask about the daily special.

  • Try combo deals to get a full food and drink experience.

  • Look for coupons online.

  • Visit during happy hour for the best prices.

Visit Amigos Today for Classic Mexican Flavors

So whether you’re craving cheesy queso, zesty tacos, or a refreshing drink, Amigos is your go-to Mexican restaurant for unbeatable daily specials. Find a location near you, grab your friends, and enjoy a classic meal that makes every hour feel like a happy hour.

Amigos Contact and Locations

For the latest menu, hours, or to find your nearest Amigos restaurant, visit their official site or call your local location.

Enjoy classic Mexican flavors at Amigos – where every day is a special day!
